description.value:
Your body is infused with nanites programmed to execute specific protocols called arrays. During your daily preparations, you can register one or more pieces of equipment in your possession as nanocyte gear until your next daily preparations. You can't have more registered nanocyte gear than the number of nanocyte archetype feats you have, and no piece of nanocyte gear can have a Bulk greater than your Constitution modifier.

Your nanites completely cover your registered nanocyte gear, allowing it to be harmlessly broken down and stored within your body. While stowed, your nanocyte gear is hidden from inspection that can't detect nanites. If your registered nanocyte gear is more than 10 feet away from you at the end of your turn, it turns into its nanite form and returns to your body, stowed. If you are knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious] or die, stowed nanocyte gear appears in your space, fully formed.

In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Gear Array] action.

Special You can use Gear Array as a free action triggered when you roll for initiative.
